name: flappy-dash-capacitor
description: Flappy Dash web build (Expo export) wrapped in a native WebView with Capacitor

scripts.web: cd ../.. && bun run export:web && rm -rf ports/capacitor/www && cp -r dist ports/capacitor/www
scripts.android: test -d android || cap add android; cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
